quotes.text: Thunderbird supplies a getAddonMessageInfo hook to the upstream add-on card. After upstream changed the expected link data, returning a resolved linkText caused console errors when a disabled incompatible add-on was shown. This patch returns the Fluent linkId instead, letting the card localize it. Check the current upstream hook contract whenever changing Thunderbird embedder data; a locally plausible object can still fail at the integration boundary.
